_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): Bran in the village if spared (hub_bran): rebuilding what he burned.

text.zh_TW: 布蘭一個人在重建燒掉的房子，滿身是灰。村民們遠遠地看著他，還沒有人跟他說話。他看見你，停下手：「……一間一間來。」
text.en: Bran is rebuilding the burned houses alone, covered in ash. The villagers watch him from a distance. Nobody has spoken to him yet. He sees you and stops. "...One house at a time."
